events.description: Executed an agreement in September 2016 to purchase 100% of Appalachia Gathering System (AGS) and 40% of Stonewall Gas Gathering (SGG) from M3 Midstream, and 15% of SGG from Vega Energy Partners for a combined purchase price of $1.3 billion. The transaction closed on October 20, 2016.
events.source_quote: In September 2016, DTE Energy executed an agreement to purchase midstream natural gas assets... The agreement called for DTE Energy to purchase 100 percent of AGS, located in Pennsylvania and West Virginia, and 40 percent of SGG, in West Virginia, from M3 Midstream. In addition, DTE Energy agreed to purchase 15 percent of SGG from Vega Energy Partners. On October 20, 2016, DTE Energy closed on the purchase of these gathering assets. The combined purchase price for the assets acquired by DTE Energy was $1.3 billion...

events.description: Closed the Shenango Incorporated coke battery plant in Pittsburgh, PA in January 2016.
events.source_quote: Shenango Incorporated is a coke battery plant located in Pittsburgh, PA, that was closed in January 2016 and is included in the Power and Industrial Projects segment.

events.description: Paid stipulated penalties totaling $534,000 in September 2016 under a 2012 consent decree for water and air matters since 2012 to PADEP, EPA, and ACHD.
events.source_quote: The decision to close the Shenango facility has prompted the PADEP, the EPA, and the ACHD to submit demand letters under the 2012 consent decree for stipulated penalties related to water and air matters since 2012. The stipulated penalties totaling $534,000 were paid in September 2016.

events.description: Appealed a demand of $481,275 from ACHD on August 19, 2016 to resolve alleged clean air act violations related to the Shenango plant closure.
events.source_quote: After closure of the Shenango coke plant, ACHD issued a demand for $481,275 to resolve the facility’s certain alleged clean air act violations. Shenango filed an appeal of such demand on August 19, 2016.

events.description: Woodland Biomass Power, Ltd. and DTE Woodland, LLC (subsidiaries) were investigated by Yolo County District Attorney's office for ash disposal practices, with DTE Energy accruing approximately $3 million for the matter as of September 30, 2016.
events.source_quote: The District Attorney's office of Yolo County, California is investigating the ash management and disposition practices of Woodland Biomass Power, Ltd., and DTE Woodland, LLC, wholly-owned subsidiaries of DTE Energy (the Woodland Companies)... As of September 30, 2016, DTE Energy had approximately $3 million accrued for this matter.

events.description: Issued $675 million of 2016 6.50% Equity Units and $1.0 billion in Senior Notes ($400 million 1.50% Series D Senior Notes due 2019 and $600 million Series E 2.85% Senior Notes due 2026) in October 2016 to finance the gathering assets acquisition.
events.source_quote: In October 2016, DTE Energy issued $675 million of 2016 6.50% Equity Units... In October 2016, DTE Energy issued $400 million of 2016 Series D 1.50% Senior Notes due 2019 and $600 million of Series E 2.85% Senior Notes due 2026. The proceeds from the Senior Notes were used for the acquisition and general corporate purposes.

events.description: DTE Electric issued $300 million of 3.70% Mortgage Bonds due 2046 in May 2016, and DTE Energy issued $300 million of 5.375% Junior Subordinated Debentures due 2076 in May 2016.
events.source_quote: In 2016, the following debt was issued: Company: DTE Electric, Month: May, Type: Mortgage Bonds, Interest Rate: 3.70%, Maturity: 2046, Amount: $300 [million]; Company: DTE Energy, Month: May, Type: Junior Subordinated Debentures, Interest Rate: 5.375%, Maturity: 2076, Amount: 300 [million]

events.description: Redeemed $300 million of 6.35% Senior Notes in June 2016 and $10 million of 7.904% Mortgage Bonds in March 2016.
events.source_quote: In 2016, the following debt was redeemed: Company: DTE Electric, Month: March, Type: Mortgage Bonds, Interest Rate: 7.904%, Maturity: 2016, Amount: $10 [million]; Company: DTE Energy, Month: June, Type: Senior Notes, Interest Rate: 6.35%, Maturity: 2016, Amount: 300 [million]

events.description: Repurchased $59 million of 5.50% Tax Exempt Revenue Bonds in August 2016, reissued them in September 2016 at 1.45% due 2029, and remarketed $82 million of Tax Exempt Revenue Bonds in September 2016 at 1.45% due 2030.
events.source_quote: In August 2016, DTE Electric repurchased $59 million of 5.50% Tax Exempt Revenue Bonds. In September 2016, DTE Electric reissued the $59 million of Tax Exempt Revenue Bonds in a long-term mode at 1.45% for a five-year term. The final maturity is August 1, 2029. In September 2016, DTE Electric remarketed $82 million of Tax Exempt Revenue Bonds in a long-term mode at 1.45% for a five-year term. The final maturity is September 1, 2030.

events.description: Self-implemented a base rate increase of $245 million on August 1, 2016, following DTE Electric's rate case filing with the MPSC on February 1, 2016 requesting a $344 million increase.
events.source_quote: DTE Electric filed a rate case with the MPSC on February 1, 2016 requesting an increase in base rates of $344 million... On August 1, 2016, DTE Electric self-implemented a base rate increase of $245 million.

events.description: Filed an application with the MPSC on May 11, 2016 for a self-implemented base rate increase of $103 million effective November 1, 2016.
events.source_quote: On May 11, 2016, DTE Gas filed an application with the MPSC for a $103 million self-implemented base rate increase effective November 1, 2016.
